email.subject: An Important Link
email.body:
Ok, you know what - I misjudged you. I'm going to go right ahead and apologize. That was nice.
So, you've proved yourself pretty decently now, and I spoke to some others and you're in. Your IP's been whitelisted (so dont go changing it for now), so you should be clear to come on through.
Welcome.
-Naix
